blackhole_missing: BlackHole 2ch was not found. System audio cannot be captured until a loopback device is available.
blackhole_steps:
1. Install BlackHole 2ch: brew install --cask blackhole-2ch, or the pkg from Existential Audio. Log out and back in if it does not appear.
2. Open Audio MIDI Setup (Applications > Utilities), click +, and choose Create Multi-Output Device.
3. Check your speakers or headphones and BlackHole 2ch. Leave BlackHole at full volume. Enable Drift Correction on BlackHole if you see it.
4. Set Discord's output (Voice & Video) or the macOS system output to that Multi-Output Device.
5. Click Refresh in this app and select BlackHole 2ch as system audio. Select your microphone as well.
6. Grant Microphone access to Terminal, your IDE, or this app in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone.
7. You hear the meeting through the speakers that belong to the Multi-Output Device. The menu-bar volume slider often does not control that mix; adjust the speaker level inside Audio MIDI Setup. Do not lower BlackHole, or the captions receive quiet audio.
Another virtual device (Loopback, Soundflower) can be selected if you already use one. This hint stays until BlackHole is detected.
windows_loopback_missing: No WASAPI loopback device was found. Install the Windows dependency pyaudiowpatch, then Refresh and choose the loopback entry for the speakers Discord is using.
